comment: Endpoints the eval can measure. HAL never ships, downloads, or runs model weights (D28); every entry here is a server someone else operates. Adding a model means adding a URL, not a checkpoint path.

m3u-qwen36-35b.note: M3 Ultra over Tailscale (DERP-relayed from home, ~400 ms floor). Start with: mlx_lm.server --model <dir> --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8902 --chat-template-args '{"enable_thinking":false}'

m3u-tb-qwen36-35b.note: Same server over the Thunderbolt bridge — office hours only, cable plugged in. Floor drops from ~400 ms (DERP relay) to tens of ms; never mix the two transports in one latency comparison.

local.note: Any server on this machine: mlx_lm.server, LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp.
